pages.text: Weavers are spider-like creatures with a distinct abdomen consisting of a rotating $(l:materials/memory_core)$(c)$(o)Memory Core$(). They use this organ to store the memories they extract from their victims and later weave them into Bloodweave. They will attack any living creature and as a side effect of consuming memories, the target will experience short-term Amnesia. They can mainly be found in $(l:structures/great_body)$(c)$(o)large nests$().
The Amnesia they cause can easily lead the victim into panic and danger.

A Weaver that wanders out of its colony has the ability to create a new Weaver Nest once it has consumed sufficient memories - which can be done through killing sufficient creatures. This process results in the death of the Weaver, as its own body is used to create the nest.
